2609.01240.title: From Language to Behavior: Scaling Sequence Transformers for Industrial Recommendation Ranking with Rec-Native Designs
2609.01240.paper_summary: Scaling Transformers has driven large gains in language modeling, but transplanting this to behavior-sequence modeling in production ranking is challenging: recommendation differs in signal quality, where behavior sequences are noisy, temporally irregular, and sparsely supervised, and in computation asymmetry, where each request scores many candidates against one shared user history under tight latency budgets. We propose ReST, a recommendation-native Transformer scaling framework. For signal quality, it introduces a sequence encoder with dual-gated attention, rotary positional and temporal embedding, stabilized residual normalization, and training-only auxiliary objectives. For computation asymmetry, it factorizes ranking into a heavy reusable encoder and a lightweight cross decoder with projection-free KV attention and token-specific parameterization, coupling user-level shared-prefix training with shared-prefix serving for compute-once, decode-many-times ranking. Across industrial and public benchmarks, ReST achieves higher accuracy and scales more consistently along sequence length, depth, and width, where LLM-style Transformer blocks saturate. A one-week online A/B test on a production advertising platform improves online AUC by 1.31% and lifts a core revenue metric by 11.93% within a 50 ms P99 budget; ReST has since been fully deployed in production, showing that behavior-sequence scaling remains a promising, under-exploited axis for production ranking.
2609.01240.paper_summary_zh: 擴展 Transformers 在語言建模上帶來了巨大的增益，但將其移植到生產排名中的行為序列建模卻面臨挑戰：推薦在信號質量上有所不同，行為序列是嘈雜的、時間上不規則的，並且監督稀疏；在計算不對稱性上，每個請求需要在緊湊的延遲預算下，針對一個共享的用戶歷史對多個候選項進行評分。我們提出了 ReST，一個推薦原生的 Transformer 擴展框架。為了提高信號質量，它引入了一個具有雙門注意力的序列編碼器、旋轉位置和時間嵌入、穩定的殘差正規化以及僅在訓練時使用的輔助目標。為了解決計算不對稱性，它將排名分解為一個重用的編碼器和一個輕量級的交叉解碼器，使用無投影的 KV 注意力和特定於標記的參數化，將用戶級的共享前綴訓練與共享前綴服務相結合，以實現一次計算、多次解碼的排名。在工業和公共基準測試中，ReST 在準確性上達到了更高的水平，並在序列長度、深度和寬度上更一致地擴展，而 LLM 風格的 Transformer 模塊則達到了飽和。在一個生產廣告平台上進行為期一週的在線 A/B 測試，將在線 AUC 提高了 1.31%，並在 50 毫秒 P99 預算內提升了一個核心收入指標 11.93%；ReST 隨後已在生產中全面部署，顯示出行為序列擴展仍然是一個有前景的、尚未充分開發的生產排名軸心。
